acceptanceCriteria.text: The CREATE PATH REJECTS an ownerless Folder BY CONSTRUCTION (Tron: 'its me as the owner') — ownerIor never null on a NEW Folder. A GUARD on new creates, NOT a backfill of the existing units. The owner is a fully-qualified instance IOR (Tron / resolved room / user).

gateRef.assertion: create a NEW Folder with no owner -> REJECTED; remove the create-guard so an ownerless Folder persists => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: remove the create-guard; an ownerless Folder is created/persisted -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: NEW Folder units carry a FULLY-QUALIFIED IOR = CLASS + PROTOCOL + ORIGIN + UUID ('ior:class:Folder:rest:<origin>/<uuid>', Tron verbatim), and the RESOLVER resolves that new form. ADDITIVE / zero-migration: the legacy bare form still parses and the 212 existing bare refs are NOT rewritten. ORIGIN is mandatory — it makes the ref resolvable ACROSS servers (federation).

gateRef.assertion: a NEW Folder ref emitted without class/protocol/ORIGIN/uuid => RED; the resolver failing to resolve the new fully-qualified form => RED; a spec that REWRITES the 212 existing bare refs (migration) => out of scope

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: emit a new Folder ref bare (no origin) OR make the parser reject the legacy form -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: Folder is a CLASS WITH METHODS (behaviour) — ask-the-object: a folder renders/resolves ITSELF via its methods (renderSelf / resolveOwnIor / children). A 0-method DATA-BAG ({uuid,name,location,kind,ext} with no behaviour) FAILS — that is the radical-OOP violation that made the tree emit strings.

gateRef.assertion: a Folder M1 class with 0 methods (pure data-bag) => RED; the folder must answer renderSelf/ior via its own methods

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed a Folder class with 0 methods (data-bag) -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: Folder is a REAL M1 Class unit (ior:class:Class name 'Folder', proper case) in the MOF/MDA chain — radical-OOP: 'a FOLDER IS a Folder class'. Every folder rendered/dragged/stored is a Folder-class INSTANCE (M0) resolved THROUGH the class, never an ad-hoc JSON blob nor a computed bare string.

gateRef.assertion: a folder surfaced without a backing M1 Folder Class => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed a folder with no M1 Folder class backing it -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: Dragging a Folder in rb-file-tree carries the REAL Folder-class unit (its fully-qualified IOR resolving to the stored unit + owner) through the ONE DnD contract (R37.20/R40.106), NOT a computed bare string ('collection:dir:...', 'collection:file:...', 'folder:<uuid>'). Drop places a LINK to that one unit.

gateRef.assertion: a folder drag payload that is a bare string instead of a resolvable fully-qualified Folder IOR => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed a folder drag emitting a bare 'collection:folder:...' string -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: Folder is delivered TOP-DOWN through the FULL 6-step MDA chain minted BEFORE any code — Requirement -> UseCase -> Class(M1) -> Method -> Implementation -> Test — NO backfill (Rule #126 purest form). Every chain link on disk before Folder code ships.

gateRef.assertion: the Folder chain missing any link at code-ship, OR any link minted AFTER its code (backfill) => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed Folder code shipped with a missing/after-the-fact chain link -> RED
